command: set -euo pipefail; python3 tools/repo/check_layering_allowlist_quality.py --root . --strict; drift=0; while read -r task_id; do if rg -l "^id: ${task_id}$" tasks/done tasks/archive -g '*.md' >/dev/null; then echo "DRIFT: allowlist owner ${task_id} is retired"; drift=1; fi; done < <(awk '/^[[:space:]]+task:/{gsub(/"/,"",$2); print $2}' tools/repo/layering_allowlist.yaml | sort -u); test "$drift" -eq 0
command_display: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; python3 tools/repo/check_layering_allowlist_quality.py --root . --strict; drift=0; while read -r task_id; do if rg -l "^id: ${task_id}$" tasks/done tasks/archive -g '"'"'*.md'"'"' >/dev/null; then echo "DRIFT: allowlist owner ${task_id} is retired"; drift=1; fi; done < <(awk '"'"'/^[[:space:]]+task:/{gsub(/"/,"",$2); print $2}'"'"' tools/repo/layering_allowlist.yaml | sort -u); test "$drift" -eq 0'
label: allowlist-drift
